title: Cordis plugin patch list (dsh bundle patch manifest)
description: Patch-list format consumed by cordis-plugin-include applyEntryPatches(): an ordered array of id-targeted overrides, disables, and insert lists. This is NOT JSON-Patch (RFC 6902); the 'insert' key is Cordis-specific.

id.description: Target entry id for non-insert patches; groups may receive config.push inserts.

name.description: Plugin module specifier for entries inserted by this patch.

insert.description: Entries appended to the targeted group's config, or to the root list when id is omitted.

disabled.description: Disable the targeted entry; !!js expressions are allowed.

inject.description: Service ids the targeted entry requires.

config.description: Config overrides merged into the targeted entry.
